subtitles.zh: 贝利，这变化有多快？现在是不是每条新闻都按分钟在变？
subtitles.en: Bailey, how fast is this changing? Is it minute by minute at this point with all of the news headlines?

subtitles.zh: 是的，邦妮。有一点要记住，当我们谈论这些订单情况时，我们听说并报道过，长线市场参与者，比如贝莱德、威灵顿、普信。
subtitles.en: So it is, Bonnie. And I think the one thing to keep in mind when we're talking about some of this book color, we had heard and reported that long-only investors, so your black rocks, your Wellington, your T-Rose.

subtitles.zh: 他们第一天就下了单，这不寻常。通常大型IPO中，大市场参与者会在最后才入场。
subtitles.en: They put in their orders the first day, which is not normal. Normally with the NIPO, the big investors, they come in at the end.

subtitles.zh: 他们先看订单簿怎么走，然后才下大单。这次所有人都抢着先入场。
subtitles.en: They see where the books playing out then they put in their big orders. Everyone rushed out of the gate.

subtitles.zh: 所以这笔交易第一天基本就超额认购三倍，我们报道过后来升到六倍，现在真是火爆。
subtitles.en: So this is a deal that was basically three times over-subscribed on day one as we reported climb to six times and really going off to the moon right now.

subtitles.zh: 贝利，你觉得这有多少是基本面，多少是稀缺性，多少是无论如何都想参与？因为你说这不寻常，但很多交易员都在这么做。
subtitles.en: How much Bailey do you think this is a matter of fundamentals versus scar city versus I just want to get into this, no matter what, because to your point, this is not usual, but a lot of these traders are doing.

subtitles.zh: 当我们看这笔交易时，这是第一次看到AI的需求侧。
subtitles.en: Well, so when we think about this deal, this is the first time we're going to see the demand side of AI.

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，我们一直在报道英伟达或CoreWeave以及算力需求有多大，这都没问题，但公司实际如何落地才是关键。
subtitles.en: And what I mean by that is we've been reporting on Nvidia or CoreWeave and how much demand there is for compute, which is all fine and dandy, but how our company is actually implementing that.

subtitles.zh: Anthropic将是第一个测试案例，也是市场参与者首次有机会配置纯AI公司，这家公司正努力推动进展。
subtitles.en: Anthropic is going to be the first test case and first opportunity for investors to invest in a pure play AI company that is trying to move the ball forward.

subtitles.zh: 所以当你想到Anthropic，与市场参与者交流时，它是一家公司，但如果你相信AI的终局，它也是必须配置的。
subtitles.en: So when you think about Anthropic, when we talk to investors, it's an end of one company, but it's also really a must-own if you believe in the end game of AI.

subtitles.zh: 是的，1.4万亿是一个高估值。它基于巨大的销售预期，高盛分析师在与市场参与者通话中已设定了很高的期望
subtitles.en: Yes, 1.4 trillion is a loft evaluation. It's baking in tremendous sales, Goldman Sachs analysts on calls with investors have penciled lofty expectations

subtitles.zh: 直到这个十年结束，但这确实是目前整个市场所依赖的。
subtitles.en: through the end of the decade, but that's really what the market writ large is really hinged on right now.

subtitles.zh: 而且两者之中，因为我确信OpenAI，如果你像鹰派一样在看这个，对吧？
subtitles.en: And of two though, because I'm sure open AI is if you're watching this like the hawks, right?

subtitles.zh: 他们带着一个区间进入市场。所以会有一些价格发现。
subtitles.en: They're coming to market with a range. So there will be a little price discovery.

subtitles.zh: 贝利，这变化有多快？现在是不是每条新闻都按分钟在变？
subtitles.en: Bailey, how fast is this changing? Is it minute by minute at this point with all of the news headlines?

subtitles.zh: 是的，邦妮。有一点要记住，当我们谈论这些订单情况时，我们听说并报道过，长线市场参与者，比如贝莱德、威灵顿、普信。
subtitles.en: So it is, Bonnie. And I think the one thing to keep in mind when we're talking about some of this book color, we had heard and reported that long-only investors, so your black rocks, your Wellington, your T-Rose.

subtitles.zh: 他们第一天就下了单，这不寻常。通常大型IPO中，大市场参与者会在最后才入场。
subtitles.en: They put in their orders the first day, which is not normal. Normally with the NIPO, the big investors, they come in at the end.

subtitles.zh: 他们先看订单簿怎么走，然后才下大单。这次所有人都抢着先入场。
subtitles.en: They see where the books playing out then they put in their big orders. Everyone rushed out of the gate.

subtitles.zh: 所以这笔交易第一天基本就超额认购三倍，我们报道过后来升到六倍，现在真是火爆。
subtitles.en: So this is a deal that was basically three times over-subscribed on day one as we reported climb to six times and really going off to the moon right now.

subtitles.zh: 贝利，你觉得这有多少是基本面，多少是稀缺性，多少是无论如何都想参与？因为你说这不寻常，但很多交易员都在这么做。
subtitles.en: How much Bailey do you think this is a matter of fundamentals versus scar city versus I just want to get into this, no matter what, because to your point, this is not usual, but a lot of these traders are doing.

subtitles.zh: 当我们看这笔交易时，这是第一次看到AI的需求侧。
subtitles.en: Well, so when we think about this deal, this is the first time we're going to see the demand side of AI.

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，我们一直在报道英伟达或CoreWeave以及算力需求有多大，这都没问题，但公司实际如何落地才是关键。
subtitles.en: And what I mean by that is we've been reporting on Nvidia or CoreWeave and how much demand there is for compute, which is all fine and dandy, but how our company is actually implementing that.

subtitles.zh: Anthropic将是第一个测试案例，也是市场参与者首次有机会配置纯AI公司，这家公司正努力推动进展。
subtitles.en: Anthropic is going to be the first test case and first opportunity for investors to invest in a pure play AI company that is trying to move the ball forward.

subtitles.zh: 所以当你想到Anthropic，与市场参与者交流时，它是一家公司，但如果你相信AI的终局，它也是必须配置的。
subtitles.en: So when you think about Anthropic, when we talk to investors, it's an end of one company, but it's also really a must-own if you believe in the end game of AI.

subtitles.zh: 是的，1.4万亿是一个高估值。它基于巨大的销售预期，高盛分析师在与市场参与者通话中已设定了很高的期望
subtitles.en: Yes, 1.4 trillion is a loft evaluation. It's baking in tremendous sales, Goldman Sachs analysts on calls with investors have penciled lofty expectations

subtitles.zh: 直到这个十年结束，但这确实是目前整个市场所依赖的。
subtitles.en: through the end of the decade, but that's really what the market writ large is really hinged on right now.

subtitles.zh: 而且两者之中，因为我确信OpenAI，如果你像鹰派一样在看这个，对吧？
subtitles.en: And of two though, because I'm sure open AI is if you're watching this like the hawks, right?

subtitles.zh: 他们带着一个区间进入市场。所以会有一些价格发现。
subtitles.en: They're coming to market with a range. So there will be a little price discovery.
